description: This file defines interfaces related to log view adaptation and log management within the Orleans Event Sourcing framework. It includes interfaces for reading, updating, and managing log views, as well as lifecycle hooks for activation and deactivation.

methods.name: PreOnActivate
methods.description: Lifecycle hook called during activation, before user-defined activation logic.

methods.name: PostOnActivate
methods.description: Lifecycle hook called during activation, after user-defined activation logic.

methods.name: PostOnDeactivate
methods.description: Lifecycle hook called during deactivation, after user-defined deactivation logic.

methods.name: RetrieveLogSegment
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a segment of the log between specified versions.

methods.name: Submit
methods.description: Submits a single log entry for appending.

methods.name: SubmitRange
methods.description: Submits a range of log entries atomically.

methods.name: TryAppend
methods.description: Attempts to append a single log entry atomically, returning success status.

methods.name: TryAppendRange
methods.description: Attempts to append a range of log entries atomically, returning success status.

methods.name: Synchronize
methods.description: Refreshes the log view and confirms all submitted entries.
